text:
alex_sales: quick heads-up — BrightRoute (campus routing startup) asking for an expanded campus POC. They want 6 months, ramp from 200k -> 1M tokens/mo and request extra startup credits + a discounted overage rate. Any fast path for approvals?

priya_ae: TL;DR — they have a research partnership with a university, want Redwood for student + faculty experiments. Budget is small, so credits are key. Will need SOC2 and an IP carveout in the contract (they're sensitive).

lee_se: from presales POV we also need private model access for on-prem evaluation (VPC) for the university infra. They'll need test keys + limited telemetry. Tech contact is @Dr_Santos. Can demo next Wed.

alex_sales: asked them for exact token profile — they expect spike patterns during grading weeks. estimate: month1 200k, month2 400k, month3 600k, months 4-6 1M. Want rollover if not used.

pat_dealdesk: paste proposed terms so we can sign off quickly — point me to the numbers you want (credits + discount + commit).

priya_ae: proposed:
```
- Startup grant: 150k free tokens up front
- Monthly committed baseline: 200k tokens/mo for first 3 months, then 1M tokens/mo for months 4-6
- Overage: bill at 30% off public rate, cap monthly overage charge to 2x baseline
- Rollover: unused tokens from months 1-3 can roll into month 4 only
- Security: SOC2-in-progress attestation + limited telemetry + university IP carveout
```

opsbot: automated note: "Standard Startup Grant = 50k tokens; escalation to >100k requires DealDesk approval and legal review."

pat_dealdesk: ok that explains. Two asks: (1) confirm equivalent USD commitment so Finance can accept, (2) legal to review the IP carveout + SOC2 clause. I'm tentatively +1 on 150k grant if they sign a 6mo moderate commit and agree to limited telemetry.

rae_cs: I can run the customer success onboarding plan. If we provide 150k grant we'll need a success milestone plan (weekly check-ins, prompt-eval suite) to avoid abuse.

lee_se: also flag: if they need VPC/on-prem for the uni, that'll push them to Private deployment — add a $X/month infra surcharge. Will figure exact number after infra sizing.

alex_sales: cool. Can we do a temporary promo code for the 150k grant + 30% off overage? If dealdesk signs, I'll get the university to sign an MSA addendum and share SOC2 timeline.

pat_dealdesk: action items:
- priya_ae: send estimated monthly $ exposure based on our public rate (just ballpark)
- lee_se: rough infra surcharge estimate by EOD Friday
- legal@pm: please review IP carveout + SOC2 requirement (cc'd in thread)
- rae_cs: draft milestone plan template for 6mo POC
When we have those, DealDesk can approve 150k grant + proposed overage discount. Note: require a one-sentence abuse policy inline in SOW.

alex_sales: putting it into motion. will push customer to accept milestone SOW and quick legal review. thanks all :thumbsup:

priya_ae: link to pricing page for quick calc: https://redwood.example/pricing — i'll throw preliminary numbers into a sheet and post back.

pat_dealdesk: marking this thread for follow-up. If anyone needs the temporary promo code earlier, ping me DM. Otherwise i'll hold until legal & finance confirm. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: DealDesk ticket ID created: DD-2026-4837 (automated)

alex_sales: noted ticket. will update once Dr_Santos confirms SOC2 timeline. :party_parrot:
